description: Draft 30-question Gold Standard dataset covering ten synthetic FP06 fixtures across PNG, PDF, Markdown, PowerPoint, and Word. Includes visual workflows, charts, native tables, structured text, and text-only controls.

questions.question: What are the three steps in the Metro State academic advising appointment process, in order?
questions.expected_answer: The three steps are Schedule, Prepare, and Meet, in that order.
questions.expected_evidence: The infographic shows three numbered steps connected by arrows: 1. Schedule, 2. Prepare, and 3. Meet.
questions.reviewer_notes: TC01. Standalone PNG infographic. Tests extraction of ordered workflow steps. Original FP06 fixture: tests/fixtures/fp06_input_test_cases/TC01_image_only.png

questions.question: What happens in the graduate application review workflow when an applicant has not submitted all required documents?
